title: WORD FLEET
shareText: WORD FLEET: One sentence that says what the game is and why it's fun.
description: Open the Word Fleet Game Notebook, grab a pencil, and challenge a friend to a duel of hidden words. Each battle sheet gives you one grid to hide your word-ships and another to track your shots, guesses, and clues.

steps.title: PLOT YOUR FLEET
steps.text: Each captain tears a Battle Tracker out of the notebook and keeps the printed words hidden from their opponent. Place your five words of 5, 4, 3, 3, and 2 letters on your Defense Grid, across or down, one letter per square.

steps.title: Play
steps.text: Start your attack by guessing one whole enemy word-ship. A correct guess lets you call a coordinate and take a shot. A wrong guess ends your turn. If your shot hits, take one guess at the letter in that square.

steps.title: DEMAND SURRENDER
steps.text: When you think you’ve found the entire fleet, name all five words and their exact locations. Get them all right and you win. One wrong word or location costs you the game.

rulesBlurb: Everything you need to play, on one page. The same rules are printed inside the notebook.
